description: PRD-211 — Encryption Fallback + Webhook Hardening. Six server-side crypto/edge defects across the encryption helper and the two DISTINCT Dr Green webhook subsystems (inbound callback verifier vs outbound tenant notifier — opposite trust directions, do not conflate). (1) decrypt() silently returns ciphertext AS plaintext on its failure paths (HIGH); (2) inbound verifier is a plain SHA-256 hash, not HMAC (HIGH); (3) outbound webhook deliver has no SSRF egress filter — tenant URL fetched directly (HIGH, elevated); (4) migration deadline hardcoded 2026-12-31, too far out (MEDIUM); (5) rate limiter fails open silently on Redis down, no alert (MEDIUM); (6) inbound webhook resolves tenant from attacker input BEFORE verifying signature (MEDIUM). App lives in nextjs_space/ (pnpm 10, Next 14.2.35, Prisma 6.7, Postgres 17, ioredis, zod 3.23.8, Clerk). NO Vitest yet — US-001 stands up a minimal unit harness (PRD-207 dep, brought in minimally). All fixes are flag-gated/reversible where they touch live signing or egress so nothing breaks before Gerber/Dr Green coordination (HMAC dual-accept flag, DRGREEN_WEBHOOK_SECRET verify-before-resolve flag default off, env-driven migration deadline). Source PRD: docs/PRDS/REMEDIATION/PRD-211-encryption-webhook-hardening.md. Global rules: decrypt must FAIL CLOSED (never return its input); keep timing-safe compare + 5-min replay window on the inbound verifier; use the apiError()/apiValidationError() envelope (lib/api-error.ts) for any client-facing error — never leak raw error text; immutable updates; tests load .env.test only, NEVER real secrets.
